evidence.latency: Not measured: in-memory accessor; no invented network delay

top_three.impact: One avoidable runner read and duplicate transfer for every image/PDF within the text fetch budget.
top_three.risk: Low-medium: preserve sniffing, ingestion caps, truncated reads and image preparation; no cache.

top_three.bottleneck: Patch display parses the entire diff repeatedly for a four-line preview
top_three.impact: Every persisted patch; large generated-file patches occupy the ORM thread and delay events for hundreds of milliseconds.
top_three.risk: Low-medium: pure bounded projection, exact line-number/count/window parity required.

top_three.bottleneck: Message edits load full history twice to discover a target and suffix IDs
top_three.impact: Interactive edits become slower and allocate whole-history content despite needing only IDs/role/order.
top_three.risk: Medium: preserve admission fences, rejection behavior, suffix boundary and race handling.
